objectives_fil: Mula sa dalawang magkaibang kuwento, gumawa ng tala na hiwalay ang sinabi, nakita at hindi pa natiyak, at tukuyin kung paano beripikahin ang kulang.
objectives_en: From conflicting accounts, produce a record separating reports, observations and unconfirmed details, with a way to verify the gap.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sa pagsusuri ng impormasyon, ihiwalay ang sinabi, nakita at kailangan pang beripikahin.
sections.takeaway_en: When assessing information, distinguish reports, observations and details still requiring verification.

sections.takeaway_fil: Itala lamang ang kailangan sa awtorisadong gawain; ipaliwanag ang gamit at sundin ang lokal na patakaran.
sections.takeaway_en: Record only what the authorized task needs; explain its use and follow local policy.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kapag magkaiba ang kuwento, maglinaw at magberipika bago magpasya.
sections.takeaway_en: When accounts differ, clarify and verify before deciding.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang pagwawasto ay may pinagmulan; ang kulang ay hindi pa tiyak hangga’t walang angkop na beripikasyon.
sections.takeaway_en: A correction keeps its source; a gap stays unconfirmed until suitable verification is available.

sections.takeaway_fil: Malinaw na pinagmulan at tapat na pagmarka sa kulang ang pumipigil sa hula na maging opisyal na tala.
sections.takeaway_en: Clear sources and explicit gaps prevent a guess becoming an official record.

check.prompt_fil: Wala ang card, at hindi magkatugma ang kuwento ni Liza at ng kapitbahay. Aling tala ang angkop?
check.prompt_en: The card is missing and Liza’s account differs from her neighbor’s. Which record fits?

options.fil: “Hindi interesado si Liza; ayon sa kapitbahay.”
options.en: “Liza is not interested, according to the neighbor.”

options.fil: “Ayon kay Liza, kinansela ang schedule; petsa ay ibeberipika sa rekord.”
options.en: “Liza reports a canceled schedule; date to be verified in the record.”

options.fil: “Kinansela ng health center ang lahat ng appointment.”

check.feedback_fil: Una: kahit may “ayon sa kapitbahay,” ang “hindi interesado” ay husga sa motibo, hindi natiyak na katotohanan. Ikalawa: ang ulat ay malinaw na kay Liza at may puwang na ibeberipika; ito ang angkop na paunang tala. Ikatlo: hindi pinatutunayan ng isang ulat na kinansela ang lahat ng appointment. Sa wakas, nilinaw ni Liza na hindi siya nakapunta nang wala ang kapatid at hindi niya tiyak kung kinansela ng center. Iwinastong tala: unang sinabi ni Liza ang pagkansela; nilinaw niya ang hadlang at kawalan ng katiyakan. Walang card na naipakita. Hindi pa nakumpirma ang petsa/status; hilingin sa awtorisadong midwife na tingnan ang kaugnay na rekord ayon sa lokal na access procedure. Kinumpirma ni Liza ang buod ng sarili niyang sinabi, hindi ang attendance o bagong appointment.
check.feedback_en: First: even with “according to the neighbor,” “not interested” is a judgment about motive, not an established fact. Second: the report is clearly attributed to Liza and identifies a gap for verification; this is the appropriate initial note. Third: one report does not establish that every appointment was canceled. In the ending, Liza clarifies that she could not attend when her sister was away and is unsure whether the center canceled it. Corrected note: Liza first reported cancellation; she clarified the barrier and uncertainty. No card was shown. Date/status remain unconfirmed; ask the authorized midwife to check the relevant record under the local access procedure. Liza confirms the summary of her own report, not attendance or a new appointment.
